name: ARC TCG
detailed_description:
ARC TCG is a strategic 3D card game set in a fantasy universe full of magic and challenges. Choose your hero, build unique decks with over 350 cards, and engage in intense battles with an automatic combat system that challenges your strategy and planning, in single-player and multiplayer modes.

With more than 15 heroes to choose from, every game is different. Every decision makes a difference, every move can change the course of the battle.

The semi-automatic component means that the player can focus exclusively on when and how they can play one or more cards. Creatures on the battlefield will attack automatically, however, the many abilities the game offers can turn the fate of combat around.

The order of attack always starts from left to right. Creatures that fight take damage equal to their attack value, and fighting happens most of the time when two creatures are facing each other (except for dedicated abilities that alter this behavior). Combat is therefore very simple, immediate, but at the same time it offers a very high strategic depth, as the position of the cards on the battlefield determines the order of attack, which can be altered, however, thanks to the presence of some card abilities.

Each creature has a default set of abilities up to a maximum of 4 per creature. Each ability is unique and always offers new strategies, and combining certain abilities also makes it possible to create powerful combos.

The game offers more than 50 abilities. Some of them are present only in specific factions because they are strongly contextualized, while others are shared in most creatures because they are more generic.

Each ability activates according to certain conditions: summoning, destruction, end/ start of turn, etc., thus increasing the strategic depth of the game

Each Hero has a specific ability, activated only 1 time per turn and under certain conditions. Take advantage of their characteristics with the available cards to increase your chances of victory.

There are more than 15 heroes in the game, offering more than 15 different and unique play styles!

Trigger conditions make their abilities play out in a reasoned manner further increasing the strategic depth of the game

Play with 3 different factions:

  • Humans

  • Nature

  • Dimensional

Each faction brings with it a unique abilities set, heroes, and cards, offering new game strategies

Singleplayer:

  • Relaxed: play without worrying about scores or leaderboards. Test to your decks and try pre-built ones.

  • Standard: play with your decks by challenging different levels of AI, gain experience and rewards

  • Draft: play by choosing a random pair of cards from the two proposed until you build your deck

  • Ranked: play against AI, win games, climb the rankings and earn rewards at the end of the season

  • Infinity Tower: play against the AI in a series of matches where your hero's health persists between matches. Can you conquer all the floors of the Tower?

  • Dark Maze: Play against the AI with one of the three decks available and choose the right paths through the maze. Pass through the rooms, defeat the bosses of the various realms, and reach the end of the maze. Can you become the Lord of the Dark Maze?

Multiplayer:

  • Private: play vs another player in a private match, test your decks or play with pre-built ones

  • Standard: play vs another player in public match, win rewards based on opponent "strenght"

  • League: play against another player and climb the leaderboard, advance in rank and get new rewards

In addition, the game in its current state offers:

  • 3 playable Factions

  • +350 unique cards

  • +50 unique abilities

  • +15 Heroes

  • 9 pre-built decks

  • Deck Editor: Create/Edit your decks and share them with the community!

  • Progression System

  • Online Services

  • Ranked matches

  • Singleplayer Seasons

  • Sound Effects

  • High Quality graphics

  • Multiplayer
